Dear All,
In '95 Patti and I were luckily recommended to Rodney, and have been working with him since
- I'm offering to share with you his knowledgeable eyes and his so knowing touch - on so
many levels...
Rodney Taft has helped many people with a variety of complaints, from diagnosed medical
conditions to those wanting to simply feel looser and walk taller. His discerning vision and
refined touch stem from thousands of hours of schooling and practice.
Rodney first earned his medical degree, near the top of his class, at NY Medical College in
1988. After graduation, he felt guided to help people through facilitating innate
capabilities of the body rather than the traditional drug and surgical approaches.
This started years more of study, learning and using techniques which include but not
limited to Swedish massage, Rolfing (deep muscle manipulations), craniosacral work (very
gentle manipulations), visualization, spiritual and energetic healing.
He's based in Manhattan, and will travel to you. Rodney is available at $150 per session
lasting 1 to 1.5 hours. Accomodations are made for those with financial need. Call him at
for appointments and/or questions.
He sure knows what to do... Good Luck, Gibby
